title: Promising
review: Shows a lot of promise. I will check back in a few months.

title: Glitchy
review: Glitchy

title: Simply the Best
review: I've tried other productivity apps, but none compare to this one. The features are exactly what I was looking for as a student, and it's easy to use. The todo list alone has transformed how I manage deadlines.

title: Perfect for my ... procrastination
review: I've spent more time setting up my todo list and tweaking my timer settings than actually studying. I'm not sure if that's a good thing or a bad thing.

title: Life-changing technology
review: This app has helped me stay more organised and focused. The motivational messages are great for when I'm feeling stuck, and the ability to reflect in the diary has been incredibly helpful for my personal growth. I feel I'm getting stronger every semester.

title: I dislike reading and writing
review: I opened the app and saw a todo list with tasks to add. I don't know, it seemed like a lot of effort. Where are the buttons that just do my work for me? Why can't I just press a button to get a degree?

title: My new favourite app
review: I can't believe how much more productive I am now. This app makes it so easy to manage my tasks, goals, and ideas. I also really like the diary feature for reflection ... it helps me!

title: Energising and motivating
review: I've found using this app an energising experience. The motivational messages are a great way to start the day and the timer keeps me focused. I've been using it for a few months now and it's been a great addition to my study routine.

title: Pause for thought
review: I love this app... kind of. If I complete all my todos I should get some sort of reward, or maybe a treat.

title: Buggy
review: Ok but a bit buggy

title: Frustrating to Use
review: I'm not impressed. While the idea is good, the app frequently freezes mid-timer, and the interface feels clunky. I was hoping for a smooth study experience, but instead I'm struggling with basic functionality. Will probably uninstall soon if the issues aren't fixed.

title: Looks bad
review: I haven't used this app, but it looks bad.

title: Unpolished
review: The concept is good, but it needs a lot more work.

title: Worrying
review: Why would a student productivity app send you motivational messages? Those positive affirmations are designed to make you compliant. I'm not falling for it.

title: Too basic for my needs
review: This app is too simple and doesn't have the features I'm looking for. I can't track everything I want in the todo list, there are no templates for my study style, and there's no way to tag my tasks by subject. It's ok for very basic productivity, but nothing more.

title: Disappointing experience
review: I was excited to try this app, but it's been a letdown. It crashes frequently and I've lost a few todo items. It also lacks basic features like task priorities and passcode protection. Definitely needs work.

title: Changed my approach to studying
review: I was all over the place with my revision before I found this. Now I use the timer and todo list in combination and everything feels more manageable. Genuinely helpful.

title: Not what I expected
review: The app feels unfinished. While it's easy to use, it doesn't offer much beyond the basics. There are no advanced features and the design is very plain. I was hoping for more.

title: Fun
review: I remember when I was a student and I had a paper planner and revision cards. This is like that, but digital. I like it. I'm 80 years old.

title: A waste of time
review: Being productive is a waste of my precious time. Why should I spend my time managing my tasks and study schedule when I could just wing it?

title: So much better than the others
review: This app is so much better than the other productivity apps I've tried. Most student apps seem to be just a low quality project, but this one is actually good. I like the motivational messages and the way it looks. I'm going to keep using it forever.

title: Oh! Beautiful!
review: The developer of this app is so impressively talented. I love this app. I love it so so much. Sometimes I just open the app and look at it. It's beautiful.

title: Use something else
review: Do not download it. I recommend instead to use my VR app. I'm looking forward to my first users. Please help me. Thanks.

title: Fell short of my expectations
review: This app could be really good, but it falls short in many areas. The todo list doesn't let me organise tasks in any meaningful way, and the timer is unreliable. The motivational messages don't feel personal.

title: I have a whole new life
review: I was using the timer to grind through my University coursework when one of the motivational messages said: 'The world is waiting for you.' I stopped. I looked up from my screen. I went for a walk. I started noticing things — the way the sun shines through the trees, the smell of fresh air. I've decided to give up University to become a poet. I'm going to live in a treehouse and write about the world. Thank you, app developers. Your motivational messages have sent me on a journey I never thought I'd take.

title: No support
review: It doesn't work on my Nokia 3310. Student apps should work on all devices. We are being forced to upgrade to smartphones just to use a timer. I don't like it.

title: Barely functional
review: I've had issues with the todo list not saving properly, and the timer can be slow to respond. The lack of any form of security makes me feel uneasy writing personal thoughts in the diary. Not a great experience overall.

title: Works as advertised
review: Does what it says. Timer times, todos get ticked off, diary holds my thoughts, and motivational messages say motivational things. No complaints, no fireworks.

title: I cried at a motivational message
review: I was having a terrible week with my dissertation and then the app said something really encouraging. I won't say what it said. I just cried a bit. Five stars.

title: Useful App
review: The app is useful for anyone who wants to stay organised. If you don't want to be organised, then avoid. But for everyone else, it's a useful app to have.

title: Useful
review: Useful app for study sessions, but the todo list makes me realise how many things I'm avoiding.

title: Cool for productivity
review: Cool app for student productivity, but it could use more features for managing complex workloads...

title: Nearly what I was hoping for
review: The app is fine for daily task management, but it doesn't have many advanced features. It would be great to have more timer options and diary prompts. Overall, it's usable, but there's a lot of room for improvement.

title: Useful but incomplete
review: I use the todo list every day, but the diary feels like an afterthought. Could do with some prompts or structure.

title: Too basic
review: I was hoping for a bit more from this app. It's very basic and missing key features like recurring tasks and study analytics. It's usable, but it's just too limited for serious students.

title: Timer is great
review: The timer feature is exactly what I needed for Pomodoro sessions. Really helps me focus during exam revision.

title: Awesome
review: Love this app! 😊

title: Decent app
review: The app is decent for basic student productivity but lacks a complete set of features.

title: Used it for a while
review: I've been using this app for a while, and I'm mostly happy with it. The todo list is user-friendly and I appreciate the timer. I would love better search functionality in the diary.

title: I just wanted a nap
review: I opened this app hoping it would help me avoid my dissertation. I set a timer, added a few todos, and read a motivational message. Now I have no excuse not to work. I'll give it 4 stars because at least the motivational messages are kind about it.

title: The todo list saved my assignment
review: I had four deadlines in one week. The todo list helped me break everything down into manageable chunks. I handed everything in on time. The app genuinely helped.

title: Could be better
review: The app is okay, but it could be better with more things to do. 🤔

title: Good
review: This is a good thing! 👍

title: Good but limited.
review: The app works well for basic productivity, but I feel like it's missing a lot of features. There are no advanced options for categorising tasks by priority or module, and the timer has no custom interval settings. Not a bad app, but could use more flexibility.

title: I think it's great
review: I can objectively say this is a great app.

title: Enjoyable + simple + effective
review: I enjoy using this app for staying on top of my workload. It's simple and effective, but it lacks some advanced features that I would like to see in future updates.

title: Could be better
review: The app is okay for students, but I was hoping for more. The motivational messages are nice, but I need more from the todo list to manage my assignments properly.

title: Great for Daily Study
review: This app is great for daily studying. The todo list is easy to use and the timer has some nice features 🏷️📚📝.

title: I've found something I like!
review: Wow, I've found something I like. It's not often I find something I like, but I like this. I like it a lot. I like it so much I'm going to tell my friends about it. I like it.

title: Good study companion
review: I use the timer and todo list together every day. It's helped me stop procrastinating... mostly.

title: Satisfactory
review: Satisfactory app. It might be improved with more customisation options maybe?

title: Great App, Needs a Few Tweaks
review: I really like this app for staying on top of my studies. The todo list is easy to use and the timer has a clean interface. However, I wish there were more customisation options for the timer intervals and colour themes.

title: A+
review: An A+ app for A+ students. Or any students really.

title: Satisfactory
review: The design could be more polished.

title: Five stars!!!!!
review: Yeah, I'm giving it five stars. That's five GOLD stars.

title: Essential for students
review: This is an essential app for students. It's easy to use and has a clean design. I would like to see more features like mood tracking in the diary and better export options for the todo list.

title: Almost there
review: The motivational messages are a nice touch but they repeat too quickly. The timer is solid though.

title: Almost perfect!
review: I love this app. It has everything I need as a student — great timer, simple todo list, and useful diary. My only complaint is the weird icon they gave the app.

title: Surprisingly good
review: I downloaded this expecting a basic student project and was actually pleasantly surprised. The four features work well together. Nice one.

title: Helpful for deadlines
review: The todo list is great for keeping track of deadlines. I'd love if it could sync with my university calendar though.

title: Not worth the download
review: This app has so much potential, but it's just not there yet. The timer freezes constantly, the motivational messages repeat too quickly, and the todo list has almost no features. It's good for very minimal productivity, but not much else. I won't be using it again.

title: Great
review: Very useful app! 👍

title: Mixed feelings
review: Good app, but I feel it could have a few more improvements, especially around the todo list.

title: Good experience
review: I've had a good experience with this app. I think the developers understand the importance of UX for stressed students. The app is reliable and easy to use, but it could have a few more features.

title: More timer options please
review: The timer only has one mode. I'd love custom intervals — 25 minutes study, 5 minutes break, that kind of thing. Still a solid app though.

title: Very Useful
review: This app is very useful for keeping track of my assignments and deadlines. The motivational messages are great for when I'm flagging, but I would love to see more of them.

title: As recommended by me!
review: If I was asked to recommend a student productivity app, I would definitely recommend this one.

title: Almost the perfect app
review: This app is almost perfect for my study needs. The timer and todo list work well together, but it could use more options for organising tasks by module or priority.

title: Three stars, explained
review: One star for the timer. One star for the todo list. One star for the motivational messages. The diary gets no stars from me. Three stars total.

title: Does what it says on the tin
Motivational messages are hit and miss
review: Some of the motivational messages are genuinely inspiring. Others feel like they were written by a fortune cookie. But overall it's a solid app.

title: Needs more tags
review: The app is good. I'd like to tag todo items by subject 🏷️ and maybe have some kind of progress visualisation.

title: Needs more functionality
review: The app is good, but it needs to do a bit more to make it worth my time as a serious student.

title: My tasks won't stay organised
review: I was hoping this app would help me sort out my chaotic workload. Now it just helps me see how chaotic my life is. Mission... failed!

title: Nicely implemented
review: The idea is well intentioned but nothing new. What makes the app stand out is the implementation. It's brilliantly done.

title: Suggestion
review: The app has some alright features. One suggestion: I'd like more options for organising my todo items 📚📚📚

title: Not the future
review: This app is good, but humans no longer need to be productive.

title: Needs dark mode
review: Good app. Please add dark mode. My eyes are suffering during late night study sessions.

title: Works well
review: Nice. Works well! 😊

title: Decent, but needs more work
review: The app is okay for managing my workload, but there are a few bugs and the timer sometimes loses count. It's not bad, but it's not amazing either.

title: Acceptable
review: Acceptable performance, but could use more features like streaks, gamification or better motivational messaging.

title: Very good app
review: I find this app very good for daily study sessions. It's student-friendly and the Pomodoro-style timer has been a game changer.

title: Can't fault it
review: I cannot even think of one thing I would improve with this app.

title: Handy for keeping on track
review: This app is very handy for keeping track of deadlines and study goals. The diary is a great place to reflect after a long day of lectures.

title: Good not great
review: Good for most of my study needs, but it lacks advanced features for the serious student I am 📖. I'm very serious about my studies — as everyone should be!

title: Good for most users
review: Good for everyday student use, but it lacks advanced features for serious academic planning.

title: Perfect for occasional use
review: I just need something I can use during deadline season. This app meets my needs.

title: Good Job
review: Hey, good job!

title: Reliable app
review: Quality app. Very reliable. It does what it promises, but it could use a few more features — strong encryption for the diary would be a good start.

title: Diary feature needs work
review: The diary is a nice idea but feels underdeveloped. I'd love prompts to guide my reflections, like how I'm feeling about my studies.

title: Will use again
review: I only use the timer during exam season, but I'll probably use this app again next year.

title: Good for group study
review: I recommended this to my whole study group. We all use the timer together on video calls. Would be great if it had a shared mode built in.

title: Good, but needs AI
review: This is a great productivity app, and I use it daily. The motivational messages are helpful, but I wish it had AI features — like personalised study tips or the ability to analyse how I'm spending my time. Still a solid 4 stars!

title: Love the diary
review: The diary feature is my favourite part. It's really helped me reflect on my progress and manage stress during term time.

title: Lacks colour options
review: Good app, I'd love some more options for colours 🎨 you know. The default colour scheme is ok but a bit plain for something I use every day.

title: Good
review: Good app, good colours.

title: smooth and fast
review: This app has really made studying fun again! I love how user-friendly it is, and the motivational messages actually make me want to open it. Plus, the timer is always smooth and fast!

title: Good foundation, room to grow
review: The timer and todo list work well together. I'd love to see subtasks added to the todo list in a future update.

title: Decent for exam season
review: Downloaded this during my exam revision period. The timer helped a lot. Will probably delete it once exams are over, but it served its purpose.

title: The joy of being productive
review: This app is fantastic! The simplicity and thoughtful design make it a joy to use. The motivational messages genuinely lift my spirits during stressful weeks, the todo list keeps me on track, the diary helps me reflect, and the timer keeps me focused. It's incredibly user-friendly, and the clean interface allows for easy navigation. Highly recommend for any student looking for a straightforward and well-designed productivity companion. I can't imagine my daily study routine without it. Thank you to the developers for creating such a wonderful app!

title: Could be my favourite with a few tweaks
review: So close to being a five star app. The design is clean, the features are useful, but it just needs a bit more depth — especially in the diary. I'll keep using it and hoping for updates.

title: New year, new me, new app
review: Downloaded this as part of my New Year's resolution to get organised. Three weeks in and I'm still using it, which is already a personal record.

title: Recommended by my lecturer
review: My lecturer told us to download a productivity app. I downloaded this one. It's fine.

title: Got me through my resits
review: I used the timer and todo list solidly through January resit season. I passed everything. I'm giving this app partial credit.

title: A Valentine to productivity
review: I have no Valentine this year. I have this app. It is not the same.

title: Still going strong
review: Been using this since January and it hasn't let me down yet. The todo list is part of my daily routine now.

title: Needs updating
review: Some parts of the app feel a bit dated now. A refresh would be welcome.

title: Solid all-rounder
review: Does all four things reasonably well. Not the best at any of them, but having everything in one place is genuinely useful.
